clips.title: The story
paras: At Northshire Abbey, Marshal McBride commands Stormwind's garrison and defends the valley. Kobolds threaten its farms and mines, so he directs new recruits against them.

Marshal McBride commands Stormwind's garrison outside Northshire Abbey. The abbey is a place of faith and learning, while unrest across the kingdom has left military garrisons short of soldiers. With only a handful of sworn guards, McBride must keep the valley peaceful and protect its food and resources. Green recruits arrive seeking training from the abbey's masters, and he must put them to work.

Kobolds have grown more aggressive around Northshire. Once a nuisance, they have spread through the woods and seized Echo Ridge Mine, an important local resource. Short of regular soldiers, McBride calls on paladins, warriors, and other novices to drive back the tunneling kobolds and learn how far the infestation reaches before the valley is cut off.
